MHT-CET Cell Seeks Police Probe Over Viral Exam Irregularity Allegations

The Maharashtra Common Entrance Test (MHT-CET) Cell has requested a police and cyber investigation into viral videos and audio clips alleging irregularities in the MHT-CET exam and admissions. These allegations include claims of a special centre costing ₹12 lakh. The viral content has cast a shadow over the examination process, prompting the MHT-CET Cell to file a formal police complaint.
